tools.name: search_oqmd_optimade_structures
tools.description: Search the anonymous OQMD OPTIMADE v1 structures endpoint by an exact set of element symbols. Returns normalized lattice/site coordinates, ordered POSCAR when representable without losing occupancy, a Vega-compatible property table, and byte-level provenance.

tools.name: search_cod_crystals
tools.description: Bounded COD metadata search. Supply either 1-20 seven-digit COD IDs or one 1-8-element space-separated Hill-style formula. A count request runs first; JSON is not fetched when matches exceed maxMatches.

tools.name: fetch_cod_cif
tools.description: Fetch one exact COD CIF, optionally at a COD revision. Preserves the exact UTF-8 CIF and byte hash, plus conservative cell and deposited asymmetric-unit atom-site normalization for a host 3Dmol renderer.

tools.name: analyze_lattice_metrics
tools.description: Validate and compute lattice-cell volume from a hash-verified normalized COD CIF or OQMD OPTIMADE structure. CIF volume uses the triclinic cell formula; OPTIMADE volume uses the absolute lattice determinant. Density is computed only when explicit composition, formula-units Z, and formula weight are all present; none are inferred.

tools.name: describe_materials_science_capabilities
tools.description: Return exact provider, guard, data-contract, renderer, and limitation declarations for this plugin.
